14:1.sourceText: Ἐν ἐκείνῳ τῷ καιρῷ ἤκουσεν Ἡρῴδης ὁ τετραάρχης τὴν ἀκοὴν Ἰησοῦ,

unmappedSource.reason: The Greek article is not separately expressed with that time.

groups.note: The actual dative article/servants phrase supplies the saying recipients, expressed as to ... servants around the separately anchored his possessor.
The actual aorist passive raising verb ἠγέρθη is rendered intransitive rose; the original raising form remains visible without an inferred raising agent.
The actual power/mighty-work noun δυνάμεις is rendered mighty energies; the source head remains δύναμις rather than an invented separate Greek energy noun.
